summary: Steve Bannon, Brian Kolfage and two associates were indicted in 2020 for secretly diverting donor money from We Build the Wall, a crowdfunded US border wall campaign that promised every dollar would go to construction.
keywords: We the People Build the Wall

evidence.note: Indictment says the crowdfunding campaign launched in December 2018
Defendants learn of a federal investigation in October 2019 and start hiding the scheme
Status at release: both men out on bond after the August 2020 arrests, pleaded not guilty
Kolfage's background as wounded airman and Facebook fake-news operator
Bannon's nonprofit pushing economic nationalism, called fascist by the hosts
Hosts discuss the scheme exploiting donors' fear of migrants and racial anxiety
Wire fraud charge and forfeiture of accounts and the boat read from the indictment

notes: Episode mostly reads the 2020 SDNY indictment aloud; kept as current-affairs per formats.yaml example rather than media-reading. Kolfage gets as much airtime as Bannon but is kept secondary since the title centres Bannon. Roles are optional for this format; supplied for Bannon anyway.
